005456 PROCEDURE DIVISION USING W77-SISTEMA-PARAMETRO.                  140200      
005457  DECLARATIVES.                                                   140205      
005458  HI-INTERRUPT SECTION.                                           140210      
005459       USE AS INTERRUPT PROCEDURE.                                140215      
005460  INTERRUP-BY-HI.                                                 140220      
005461       DISALLOW INTERRUPT.                                        140225      
005462       MOVE ATTRIBUTE TASKVALUE OF MYSELF TO W77-INTERRUP.        140230      
005463       IF W88-HI8                                                 140232      
005464          PERFORM 80000-HI8                                       140233      
005465       ELSE                                                       140234      
005466       IF W88-HI9                                                 140235      
005467          PERFORM 80100-HI9                                       140236      
005468       ELSE                                                       140237      
005469* FIN VML                                                         140238      
005470       IF W88-HI1                                                 140239      
005471          MOVE A00-R01-AUT-S151        TO  W77-LEIDOS             140240      
005472          MOVE "I"                     TO  TIPO-LJ                140242      
005473          MOVE 020101                  TO  CODIGO-LJ              140244      
005474          STRING "REGISTROS LEIDOS " W77-LEIDOS                   140245      
005475          DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO TEXTO-LJ                         140246      
005476          CALL "LJ IN LIB-DISP" USING CONTADOR-LJ, MENSAJE-LJ     140247      
005477       ELSE                                                       140248      
005478       IF W88-HI2                                                 140250      
005479          MOVE 1                       TO W77-FIN-POR-HI          140255      
005480       ELSE                                                       140260      
005481          MOVE "I"                     TO TIPO-LJ                 140265      
005482          MOVE 020101                  TO CODIGO-LJ               140267      
005483          MOVE "HI 1 DESPLIEGA REG LEIDOS  " TO TEXTO-LJ          140269      
005484          CALL "LJ IN LIB-DISP" USING CONTADOR-LJ, MENSAJE-LJ     140270      
005485          MOVE "HI 2 SIMULA FUNCION 97 O 98" TO TEXTO-LJ          140272      
005486          CALL "LJ IN LIB-DISP" USING CONTADOR-LJ, MENSAJE-LJ.    140274      
005487       ALLOW INTERRUPT.                                           140285
